skill.name: post-purchase-upsell-flow
skill.description: Design and implement one-click post-purchase upsells and downsells that raise average order value without hurting the main conversion rate. Use when asked to increase AOV, add an upsell, cross-sell or downsell after checkout, build a one-click upsell flow, monetize the thank-you page, or when someone asks how to make more revenue per customer from the same ad spend.
skill.summary: Plan and implement ethical one-click upsell and downsell flows after payment.
skill.author: autonnel

content.value_statement: Many stores lose revenue after the initial purchase because the thank-you page has no relevant next offer. This skill helps design and implement a measured upsell or downsell flow without disrupting the original checkout.
actual_capabilities: Designs complementary upsell, downsell, and cross-sell offers after payment.
Maps short offer chains with clear accept, decline, and confirmation paths.
Defines requirements for stored payment methods, merged orders, refunds, and idempotency.
Recommends page copy for headlines, benefits, proof, pricing, and honest declines.
Defines metrics and one-variable tests for take rate, AOV, refunds, and chargebacks.
Provides implementation guidance for hosted platforms and self-hosted funnel systems.
limitations: It does not directly modify a checkout, payment provider, store, or funnel platform.
Provider behavior must be verified because Stripe, PayPal, and SCA flows differ.
Recommendations require real transaction testing before production traffic.
It does not guarantee higher AOV, conversion, or profitability.

use_cases.title: Plan a complementary offer
use_cases.description: Create a relevant post-purchase offer that completes the customer need without adding friction to the original checkout.

use_cases.title: Specify the payment flow
use_cases.description: Turn an upsell concept into technical requirements for charging, order merging, refunds, authentication, and duplicate prevention.

use_cases.title: Measure funnel impact
use_cases.description: Set guardrail metrics and a testing sequence for offer take rate, AOV, refunds, base conversion, and chargebacks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an upsell
prompt_templates.prompt: I sell [product] to [customer]. Suggest one complementary post-purchase upsell, its price range, and a plain decline option.

prompt_templates.title: Draft the offer page
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a post-purchase upsell page for [base product] and [upsell]. Include a headline, one benefit, proof, price, accept button, decline link, and confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Design the offer chain
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a two-decision upsell and downsell chain for [store]. Specify accept, decline, authentication failure, refund, and thank-you paths.

prompt_templates.title: Review an implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this post-purchase flow against stored payment credentials, merged orders, deferred store sync, per-charge refunds, event value updates, idempotency, SCA, and chargeback safeguards: [details].

output_examples.input: Base product: yoga mat. Customer: first-time home practitioner. Goal: add a relevant post-purchase offer.
output_examples.output: Offer: a durable carry strap for $19. Page: explain that the strap makes storage and transport easier. Accept: Add the strap for $19. Decline: No thanks, continue to my order.

output_examples.input: Need technical requirements for a Stripe post-purchase upsell.
output: Save the payment method for off-session use with the correct customer consent.
Record each charge separately so the upsell can be refunded without refunding the base order.
Make the accept action idempotent and provide an authentication fallback for SCA challenges.

output_examples.input: Need a testing plan for one upsell offer.
output_examples.output: Test the offer first, then price, then headline. Track take rate, AOV, refund rate, base conversion, and monthly chargebacks. Do not declare a winner from a small sample.

best_practices: Offer a complementary product that solves the next customer need.
Keep the chain short and make accepting or declining clear and honest.
Test one variable at a time while monitoring refunds and chargebacks.
anti_patterns: Do not use hidden or guilt-based decline language.
Do not use fake countdown timers or reference prices.
Do not ship without testing payment failure, decline, refund, and duplicate-tap paths.

faq.question: What is a post-purchase upsell?
faq.answer: It is an offer shown after payment that lets a buyer add a relevant product without repeating the full checkout.

faq.question: Can this skill build the integration?
faq.answer: It can define the design and technical requirements, but it does not directly edit your commerce or payment platform.

faq.question: What makes an offer relevant?
faq.answer: A strong offer complements the purchased product and addresses a need that becomes clear after the original purchase.

faq.question: How many offers should a flow include?
faq.answer: Most funnels should use one primary offer and an optional downsell. Long chains increase fatigue and support requests.

faq.question: What metrics should I track?
faq.answer: Track offer take rate, AOV, refund rate, base conversion, and chargebacks. Use refunds and chargebacks as guardrails.

faq.question: Why are payment details important?
faq.answer: A one-click charge requires a payment method that the provider permits for off-session use, plus appropriate consent and failure handling.
